headline: Victor Cațavei: 'Romania's economy shrank by 0.8% in the first half of 2026 compared with the same period last year. A huge alarm signal' -
summary: Romania's economy shrank by 0.8% in the first half of 2026 compared with the same period last year, according to an AUR commission coordinator's criticism of the data.
why: GDP trends signal the health of an economy and influence central bank policy, sovereign borrowing costs and investor sentiment toward Romania.
